name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme- For Incubators
nodalDept: Department For Promotion Of Industry And Internal Trade
briefDescription: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme for Incubators (SISFS-FI) gives DPIIT-approved incubators grants of up to ₹5 crore to further distribute as seed funding to early-stage startups under their wings.
descriptionMd:
The Startup India Seed Fund Scheme — For Incubators (SISFS-FI) component, launched by DPIIT on 19 April 2021 with a ₹945 crore corpus, provides financial assistance to eligible incubators so they in turn can seed-fund the startups they support. It is the supply-side of the SISFS ecosystem: the scheme (SISFS-FS) directly funds startups; this component (SISFS-FI) funds the incubators that mentor and disburse to those startups.

Incubators can use the grant to give startups grants of up to ₹20 lakh (proof-of-concept) or up to ₹50 lakh (market entry/scaling) under convertible instruments.
benefitsMd:
- **Grant of up to ₹5 crore** per selected incubator, released in milestone-based instalments (three or more tranches).
- A **5% Management Fee** of the total seed fund grant is additionally provided to cover incubator administration costs.
- Incubators can distribute funds to startups as:
  - **Grants of up to ₹20 lakh** for proof-of-concept or prototyping
  - **Up to ₹50 lakh** in convertible debentures, debt or debt-linked instruments for market entry and scaling
eligibilityMd:
The incubator must:
1. Be a **legal entity** — a registered Society (Societies Registration Act 1860), Trust (Indian Trusts Act 1882), or Section 8 Company (Companies Act 2013).
2. Be **established for at least 2 years** as on the date of application.
3. Have at least **5 active startups** currently being incubated.
4. Have **adequate physical infrastructure** — office space, lab/prototyping facilities.
5. Have full-time incubation staff with relevant experience.
6. Demonstrate a track record of mentoring, funding or commercialising startups.
applicationMd:
Applications for SISFS-FI are accepted on a rolling basis:

**Step 1:** Go to the Startup India Seed Fund portal at [seedfund.startupindia.gov.in](https://seedfund.startupindia.gov.in/).
**Step 2:** Click **'Apply Now'** under the **Incubator** section.
**Step 3:** Log in or register with your Startup India / DPIIT credentials.
**Step 4:** Fill in the incubator profile — legal entity details, infrastructure, current portfolio startups, track record.
**Step 5:** Submit the application along with the Detailed Incubation Plan describing how you will disburse and monitor seed funds for startups.
**Step 6:** The Expert Advisory Committee (EAC) evaluates applications and announces selected incubators, who sign an agreement with DPIIT before receiving funds.
